blocks.text: Central air conditioning, a bike room, storage and wheelchair access.
Belaire is on North Bluff Road, the city’s northern edge, west of the Town Centre. The strata allows pets and rentals with restrictions; ask for the current bylaws.

items.t: the Form B, two years of minutes, the bylaws, the depreciation report and the contingency reserve fund balance. They show what Belaire owners are planning to fix and pay for.
since November 24, 2022, BC stratas cannot ban owners from renting, except in age-restricted buildings. Short-term rental limits can still apply.
pet limits, parking stalls, storage lockers and electric car charging are set by the bylaws and the title, home by home. Check them for the exact home you are buying.
